about: Colors as data. `accents` are the named accent themes (HSL), `default` the one used unless a card asks for another, `base` the CSS color variables of the dark glass look (text colors ink / foreground included), `schemes` what changes when the page behind is dark, light or mid, `chart-ink` the RGB the chart canvases draw their text in on dark or light cards. Override any key in your prefs/ui.json under "themes"; the host reloads this file by itself when it changes. `platforms.<os>` (mac, win) is laid over the rest on that system: its own default accent, accents, base and schemes. `skin` names a material set the CSS keys off (html[data-skin=...]): none = the default plates; `glass` = see-through tint, grain, glints and dark lens pills (on macOS over native Liquid Glass).

mac.about: macOS: the glass skin over native Liquid Glass (src/platform/macos/glass.rs), cool dark surfaces, a deep steel-blue accent (user, 10 Nov: tired of the orange). Mostly dark: the backdrop sampling still picks the scheme, but a dark page keeps dark surfaces here.

glass.about: Dark glass: a see-through tint with dark grain, glints and a soft light that follows the pointer (macOS: over native Liquid Glass), and dark lens pills inside (rows, badges, plain buttons: black rim, thin grey line, white text). Turn it on with `skin: "glass"` (top level, per platform, or in prefs/ui.json under themes). Sizes: ui/tokens/lens.json.
